generalAbilities.name: Echolocation
generalAbilities.description: A skaveling can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range

offensiveAbilities.name: Bone-Chilling Screech
offensiveAbilities.description:
The skaveling unleashes a horrifying screech that chills the very bones of those close enough to feel it. The screech can be heard for miles, but each creature in a 20ft Emanation must also attempt a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save.

The skaveling can't use Bone-Chilling Screech again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Bone- Chilling Screech for 24 hours.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 2 and Stunned 1 by fear.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The skaveling is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour

Effect The skaveling devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 1d6 Hit Points plus 1d6 for every 2 levels the skaveling has. They can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feast on Fear
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The skaveling deals damage to a frightened creature with a fangs Strike

Effect The skaveling draws power from the fear infusing a creature's flesh. The frightened creature must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed, and the skaveling gains a +5-foot status bonus to their Speeds until the end of their next turn.

Failure The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed, and the skaveling gains a +10-foot status bonus to their Speeds until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is Slowed 1, and the skaveling can immediately Fly, Step, or Stride as a free action; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 2d6 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a ghoul the next midnight

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description:
Any creature hit by the skaveling's Strikes must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Slowed 1.

Failure The creature is Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Dart
offensiveAbilities.description: The skaveling Flies up to half their Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
